margin.thresholdJustification:
Threshold = 1.0 logprob on the deviation_gap = (tree's OWN clean teacher-forced argmax logprob) - (tree's served-token logprob in that same clean distribution). NEAR-TIE iff deviation_gap <= 1.0 (the served token is at least ~e^-1 = 37% as probable as the tree's own argmax — a genuine near-tie band where fp-noise / a different-backend GEMM rounding can legitimately flip the argmax); CLEAR-MARGIN if > 1.0 (the tree's own target distribution clearly prefers another token, so serving the rank-2 token is a real deviation not a noise tip).

This deviation_gap framing is the correct discriminator (not raw cross-arm margins) because the decisive question is whether the tree SERVED a token its own target would reject. I measured it against the tree's OWN clean distribution, eliminating the cross-backend-width confound entirely.

CRITICAL INSTRUMENT CORRECTION: the tree arm's STREAMING top_logprobs are unreliable (the vLLM spec-decode logprob-reporting array is misaligned at ~12/128 accept positions: served-token != reported-argmax). Validated by teacher-forcing the tree on byte-identical internal prefixes (pos 9/10/11/15/16/18 all reproduce the served token AS the clean argmax). Native arm has ZERO misalignments. Therefore ALL margins use CLEAN max_tokens=1 teacher-forced distributions on the byte-identical shared prefix at each fork. Method validated: native teacher-force reproduces native's streamed token at every fork (faithful); the asymmetry (native TF==stream, tree TF!=stream at p0/p2/p3) localizes the defect to the tree serving path.

margin.summary:
RESOLVED the open red-team item (probe prompt-0 greedy margin) with MEASURED per-token margins, not assertion. Verdict: CLEAR-MARGIN present — a real, reproducible serving-path divergence, NOT a benign cross-backend near-tie everywhere.

Two of the four greedy forks are lossless near-ties (p0 fork17: both backends pick ' structure', tree tipped to ' and' at a 0.375-logprob near-tie; p1 fork11: genuine ' workspace' vs ' repository' tie, each ranks the other rank-2 at margin 0.125, tree served its OWN argmax). But two forks are a REAL loss: at p2 (fork21) and p3 (fork68) BOTH backends agree the clean greedy argmax (' files', '```'), yet the TREE spec-decode SERVED stream emitted a rank-2 token its own clean target clearly rejects (deviation 2.125 and 5.125 logprob; at p3 the served 'Let' has ~0.6% prob vs the argmax '```' at ~99%).

Critical instrument finding that unblocked the classification: the tree arm's STREAMING top_logprobs are unreliable at spec-decode accept positions (~12/128 misaligned), so I measured all margins from CLEAN max_tokens=1 teacher-forced distributions on byte-identical shared prefixes. The method is validated (native teacher-force reproduces native's streamed tokens exactly; tree teacher-force reproduces tree's served tokens at internal positions but NOT at the deviation positions) — which precisely localizes the defect to the tree spec-decode COMMITTER serving a non-argmax token at a subset of accept boundaries (clustered at structural/template boundaries: code-fences, stop-token region). Native E5's served stream is greedy-exact (0 deviations); the tree's is not (5/82 deviations in prompt 0). This is a logic/commit-path bug (a 5-logprob argmax flip is not a numeric seam), not the lossless backend near-tie the gold-gate yellow flag hoped for.

The FR13_B1_SWE_GOLD_BIND.md agentic-SWE within-floor BINDING verdict is unchanged (different stream, held). greedy-lossless-within-backend-floor is NOT confirmed for the rider probes; a localized tree-committer-row divergence remains for a follow-up fix (NOT attempted here per task). Decisive next test specified: in-process per-accept-boundary committer-row gate asserting committed-id == argmax(verify-forward logits) on the tree server. Artifacts in /home/mark/shared/lumoFlyWheel/output/fr13_gold_margin/ (tree_capture.json, native_capture.json, tree_teacher_force.json, native_teacher_force.json, margin_reduce_clean.json); draft note /home/mark/shared/lumoFlyWheel/FR13_GOLD_MARGIN_BIND.md; probe script /home/mark/shared/lumoFlyWheel/scripts/fr13_gold_margin_probe.py.
